_comment: Time-boxed exceptions to the ECR scan gate (scripts/ecr_scan_gate.py).
The gate blocks HIGH/CRITICAL by default. An entry here is the only way a
finding may be promoted, and every entry must state why the vulnerable code
is unreachable, who owns it, and when it must be looked at again.
An entry whose review_by date has passed is treated as a failure by the

exceptions.reason: Heap buffer overflow in gz_vacate(), reachable only through the streaming gzwrite()/gzprintf() API with stale external buffer pointers. The image includes libz only as a transitive OS library; the application and its dependencies use the one-shot zlib.compress/decompress path, never the streaming gz* API.
exceptions.upstream: No fixed Debian version exists yet: apt-cache policy reports installed 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+b1 == candidate in trixie.

exceptions.reason: Out-of-bounds write in strfmon()/strfmon_l() with right-justified width padding. Neither the application nor its dependencies call strfmon or strfmon_l.
exceptions.upstream: No fixed Debian version exists yet: libc6 2.41-12+deb13u4 installed == candidate in trixie.

exceptions.reason: Out-of-bounds write in the deprecated ns_printrrf/ns_printrr/fp_nquery DNS record printers when printing TSIG records. The service performs no DNS record printing and does not link a resolver that uses these symbols.
